verdict.rationale: Responsive layout is a fair axis for a design tool, but the evidence pack never documents auto layout, constraints, or layout grids resizing frames. It offers only a generic marketing line about "best-in-class layout tools" and MCP extraction of "layout data", which do not show that frames resize responsively.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex
